title: AgentRoom: Concurrent Multi-Agent Coding in a CRDT-Backed Shared Workspace
abstract: arXiv:2608.23740v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Concurrent multi-agent coding promises division of labor across modules, robustness through redundancy, and parallel exploration at the natural granularity of multi-file projects. Realtime collaborative editing protocols solve this coordination problem for human teams via Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), but the LLMs underneath generate one token at a time and existing multi-agent coding systems inherit this serial limit: they either sequence agents through phase handoffs or pool independent samples without coordination, and a single agent abandons up to half of hard tasks with a one-file stub-and-exit. AgentRoom is a realtime collaborative editing protocol for concurrent coding agents. Its runtime layer exposes file-level claim, status, and broadcast as MCP tools on a CRDT-merged shared filesystem. Five frontier coding-CLI models ran four backend coding tasks, with cross-language checks in Python DevBench and Rust+axum. For

translated_title: AgentRoom：基于CRDT支持的共享工作空间中的并发多智能体编程
translated_abstract: 并发多智能体编程承诺在模块间实现劳动分工，通过冗余提高鲁棒性，并在多文件项目的自然粒度上进行并行探索。实时协作编辑协议通过无冲突复制数据类型（CRDTs）解决了人类团队的协调问题，但底层的大型语言模型一次只生成一个令牌，现有的多智能体编程系统继承了这种串行限制：它们要么通过阶段交接顺序执行智能体，要么池化独立样本而不进行协调，单个智能体在困难任务上可能以单文件存根和退出方式放弃多达一半的任务。AgentRoom是一种用于并发编程智能体的实时协作编辑协议。其运行时层在CRDT合并的共享文件系统上，通过MCP工具暴露文件级别的声明、状态和广播。五个前沿编程CLI模型运行了四个后端编程任务，并通过Python DevBench和Rust+axum进行了跨语言检查。
tldr: AgentRoom提出了一种基于CRDT的实时协作编辑协议，使多个编程智能体能在共享工作空间中并发协作，解决现有系统的串行限制，显著提升任务完成率。
en_tdlr: AgentRoom introduces a CRDT-based real-time collaborative editing protocol that enables concurrent multi-agent coding in a shared workspace, overcoming serial limitations and improving task completion rates.
